package domain

import "context"

// SandboxCreator synchronously creates/retrieves a sandbox for (user, task, answer)
// over the canonical HTTP transport.
type SandboxCreator interface {
	CreateSandbox(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID, answerID string, composeConfig []byte, codeStructureTypeCode string, codeStructure []byte, starterFileStorageID string) (sandboxID, previewURL string, err error)
}
